disposition: Recent Zeta Psi sources confirm Tau Gamma student affiliation, but do not establish its current residence. Spring 2025 roster classified it as provisional with seven associates; 2026 sources list Tau Gamma members but provide no address. 237 S Grant appears obsolete and is not a current building candidate; the 950/FID748 building has an address conflict with Chi Psi’s 2024 lodge announcement. No defensible current Zeta Psi FID/footprint or model is identified.
